chain.chain_moment: Put kappa_0=log(N/m), u_0=log(a/m), C_(m,p)=Re Z_(m,p), and s_*'=c_s+i*b. Then D_(m,p)=Re[(c_s*kappa_0+i*b*u_0)Z_(m,p)-ell*s_*'*K_(m,p)].
chain.chain_transport: On every fixed-N chart and fixed chain, D_(m,p)=partial_x C_(m,p)+c_s*log(N)*C_(m,p)-R_(m,p), where R_(m,p)=sum_k r_(m*p^k). Thus a chain contact still reduces to transversality, not positivity.
chain.coefficient_family: The active coefficients are q_n=exp[t*log(n)^2/4-s_*log(n)]*(1+d_n)/(1+d_1), q_1=1. They carry coefficient +1; there is no Mobius factor in this Xi prefix.
chain.exact_factorization: Fix p prime, p does not divide m, ell=log(p), n_k=m*p^k, and R_m=floor(log_p(N/m)). With B_m=phi*exp[t*log(m)^2/4-s_*log(m)]/|1+d_1|, w_(m,p)=exp[ell*(t*log(m)/2-s_*)], and a_(m,k)=exp[t*ell^2*k^2/4]*(1+d_(m*p^k)), one has z_(m*p^k)=eta*q_(m*p^k)=B_m*a_(m,k)*w_(m,p)^k exactly.

outer_decomposition.exact_partition: For every fixed prime p, each 1<=n<=N has the unique form n=m*p^k with p not dividing m. Therefore mu=sum_(p not dividing m)mu_(m,p), P=sum_m P_(m,p), C_bulk=sum_m C_(m,p), and D_bulk=sum_m D_(m,p) exactly.
outer_decomposition.heat_rejoin: The Gaussian identity writes the heat factor as an expectation of tilted Dirichlet prefixes. The p-free decomposition telescopes for every tilt before taking the expectation. This exactly reconstructs the original prefix; expectation cannot be passed through the phase-dependent indicators 1_(s<h_n).
outer_decomposition.no_mobius_reinterpretation: The subtraction in O_M^(p)=S_M-p^(-s)S_floor(M/p) is a one-prime p-free inclusion identity. It does not turn the original carrier coefficients into Mobius coefficients and supplies no positivity.
outer_decomposition.p_free_prefix: For the correction-free Dirichlet prefix S_M(s)=sum_(n<=M)n^(-s), O_M^(p)(s)=S_M(s)-p^(-s)S_floor(M/p)(s). If R=floor(log_p N), then sum_(k=0)^R p^(-ks)O_floor(N/p^k)^(p)(s)=S_N(s) by exact telescoping.
outer_decomposition.singleton_count: Let M=floor(N/p). The number of p-free complete chains with R_m=0 is S_p(N)=N-2M+floor(M/p). For p=2, S_2(N)>=floor(N/4). Thus a fixed-prime chain split leaves order-N singleton chains with no internal completion at all.

proof_boundary: Proved: exact physical chain factorization, Euler moment, chain transport, three-level threshold guard, external-phase reversal, p-free partition, singleton count, and telescoping rejoin. Open: a joined Xi boundary margin, winding cap, q<1 chart, finite-height cofinal closure, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, and any Clay-prize conclusion.

rows.claim: The active Xi prefix has coefficient +1 and no Mobius factor.
rows.formula: The active coefficients are q_n=exp[t*log(n)^2/4-s_*log(n)]*(1+d_n)/(1+d_1), q_1=1. They carry coefficient +1; there is no Mobius factor in this Xi prefix.
rows.proof_boundary: A p-free inclusion subtraction must not be relabelled as a Mobius coefficient.

rows.claim: Every fixed prime-power chain has an exact heat-quadratic polynomial factorization.
rows.formula: Fix p prime, p does not divide m, ell=log(p), n_k=m*p^k, and R_m=floor(log_p(N/m)). With B_m=phi*exp[t*log(m)^2/4-s_*log(m)]/|1+d_1|, w_(m,p)=exp[ell*(t*log(m)/2-s_*)], and a_(m,k)=exp[t*ell^2*k^2/4]*(1+d_(m*p^k)), one has z_(m*p^k)=eta*q_(m*p^k)=B_m*a_(m,k)*w_(m,p)^k exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: The complex correction factors remain in a_(m,k).

rows.claim: The chain sum and logarithmic index moment are Q and its Euler derivative.
rows.formula: Q_(m,p)(w)=sum_(k=0)^R_m a_(m,k)w^k, Z_(m,p)=B_m*Q_(m,p)(w_(m,p)), and K_(m,p)=B_m*w_(m,p)*Q_(m,p)'(w_(m,p))=sum_k k*z_(m*p^k).
rows.proof_boundary: This is a fixed-x identity, not a zero-free theorem.

rows.claim: The physical centered first moment has an exact chain-Euler representation.
rows.formula: Put kappa_0=log(N/m), u_0=log(a/m), C_(m,p)=Re Z_(m,p), and s_*'=c_s+i*b. Then D_(m,p)=Re[(c_s*kappa_0+i*b*u_0)Z_(m,p)-ell*s_*'*K_(m,p)].
rows.proof_boundary: It is a real projection and has no automatic sign.

rows.claim: Each fixed chain inherits the normalized occupation transversality identity.
rows.formula: On every fixed-N chart and fixed chain, D_(m,p)=partial_x C_(m,p)+c_s*log(N)*C_(m,p)-R_(m,p), where R_(m,p)=sum_k r_(m*p^k). Thus a chain contact still reduces to transversality, not positivity.
rows.proof_boundary: At chain contact this remains a derivative statement.

rows.claim: Arbitrary contracted endpoint amplitudes admit a complete three-level affine-phase threshold guard.
rows.formula: Let A_0,A_1,A_2>0 with A_2<A_0, put theta_0=arccos(A_2/A_0), varphi=(pi-theta_0)/2, and theta_k=theta_0+k*varphi. Then theta_2=pi, c_0=A_2, c_2=-A_2, and c_1<0.
rows.proof_boundary: The phase parameters are not asserted to be attained by the Xi trajectory.

rows.claim: The three guard slopes are strictly ordered in the physical c_s,b range.
rows.formula: For u_0>2ell, u_k=u_0-k*ell, kappa_k=kappa_0-k*ell, beta=-b>=1/2, and 0<=c_s<1/4, h_k=c_s*kappa_k+beta*u_k*tan(theta_k) satisfies h_1<h_2<h_0. Indeed h_1-h_2<c_s*ell-beta*u_1<ell/4-ell/2<0, while h_0-h_2=2c_s*ell+beta*u_0*tan(theta_0)>0.
rows.proof_boundary: The guard is pole-free and uses u_0>2log(p).

rows.claim: A complete chain threshold profile can be negative, zero on an open interval, and positive.

diagnostics.status: Exact correction-free complete three-level chain guard, not an actual Xi point.

rows.formula: For P_(m,p)(s)=sum_(k=0)^2 c_k*1_(s<h_k), P=c_1<0 below h_1, P=c_0+c_2=0 on (h_1,h_2), and P=c_0=A_2>0 on (h_2,h_0). Thus neither a fixed sign nor a strict positive lower modulus follows from complete-chain amplitudes and affine phases.
rows.proof_boundary: This disproves chain-completion positivity, not an Xi-specific joined-prefix theorem.

rows.claim: A common half-turn reverses every projected chain sign without changing its slopes.
rows.formula: Adding pi to every theta_k leaves every h_k unchanged but sends every c_k, P_(m,p), C_(m,p), and D_(m,p) to its negative. Any composable sign theorem must control the p-free external phase B_m; internal chain contraction cannot do so.
rows.proof_boundary: The p-free external phase must be controlled jointly.

rows.claim: Fixed small coefficient phase corrections do not create coefficient-only threshold positivity.
rows.formula: For fixed correction phases delta_k, the two affine parameters alpha,varphi can still set alpha+delta_0=theta_0 and alpha+2varphi+delta_2=pi. The middle phase is (theta_0+pi)/2+delta_1-(delta_0+delta_2)/2. Small d_n corrections therefore do not create a coefficient-only sign; this does not assert that the actual Xi trajectory realizes the guard phases.
rows.proof_boundary: No actual Xi phase-attainment statement is made.

rows.claim: Every occurrence of pi has an explicit source.
rows.formula: The pi in the Xi saddle and a^2=x/(4*pi)+t/16 comes from the completed-zeta Gamma normalization. The pi in theta_2=pi is separately the half-period of exp(i*theta); no polygon or prime chain defines pi.
rows.proof_boundary: The chain does not define or approximate pi.

rows.claim: The full occupation measure is the sum of its p-free prime-power chains.
rows.formula: For every fixed prime p, each 1<=n<=N has the unique form n=m*p^k with p not dividing m. Therefore mu=sum_(p not dividing m)mu_(m,p), P=sum_m P_(m,p), C_bulk=sum_m C_(m,p), and D_bulk=sum_m D_(m,p) exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: Linearity of the measure does not imply positivity of its summands.

rows.claim: Every fixed-prime split retains order-N complete singleton chains.
rows.formula: Let M=floor(N/p). The number of p-free complete chains with R_m=0 is S_p(N)=N-2M+floor(M/p). For p=2, S_2(N)>=floor(N/4). Thus a fixed-prime chain split leaves order-N singleton chains with no internal completion at all.
rows.proof_boundary: Internal prime-power rigidity has no content on these chains.

rows.claim: The correction-free p-free rejoin telescopes to the original prefix.
rows.formula: For the correction-free Dirichlet prefix S_M(s)=sum_(n<=M)n^(-s), O_M^(p)(s)=S_M(s)-p^(-s)S_floor(M/p)(s). If R=floor(log_p N), then sum_(k=0)^R p^(-ks)O_floor(N/p^k)^(p)(s)=S_N(s) by exact telescoping.
rows.proof_boundary: The decomposition alone creates no new coercive quantity.

rows.claim: The p-free subtraction is not a Mobius-weighted Xi expansion.
rows.formula: The subtraction in O_M^(p)=S_M-p^(-s)S_floor(M/p) is a one-prime p-free inclusion identity. It does not turn the original carrier coefficients into Mobius coefficients and supplies no positivity.
rows.proof_boundary: No alternating-sign theorem may be imported from a different coefficient family.

rows.claim: Gaussian heat mixing reconstructs the same joined prefix and does not linearize threshold indicators.
rows.formula: The Gaussian identity writes the heat factor as an expectation of tilted Dirichlet prefixes. The p-free decomposition telescopes for every tilt before taking the expectation. This exactly reconstructs the original prefix; expectation cannot be passed through the phase-dependent indicators 1_(s<h_n).
rows.proof_boundary: Expectation preserves the sum identity, not zero-free winding or occupation sign.

rows.claim: The contact condition is global rather than chainwise.
rows.formula: With the recurrent endpoint retained, mathsf_X=c_0+sum_m C_(m,p) and mathcal_C_N=d_0+sum_m D_(m,p). mathsf_X=0 does not imply C_(m,p)=0 for any m.
rows.proof_boundary: A chain-contact estimate cannot be summed under only the global contact equation.

rows.claim: Prime-power chains do not evolve independently across cutoff changes.
rows.formula: When N changes, chain lengths and every kappa_k=log(N/(m*p^k)) change. Recompute terminal centering and use the exact global adjacent laws F_(N+1)-F_N=j_0+u_nz^v and Q_N=f_(N+1)+kappa_N*J_a^(adj).
rows.proof_boundary: No blockwise cutoff homotopy replaces the recurrent endpoint join.

rows.claim: Retire complete-chain threshold positivity as a standalone route.
rows.formula: Complete chains remain an exact organization of the prefix, but their projected threshold masses have no chainwise sign and a fixed-p split leaves order-N singletons. Return to the endpoint-complete joined first-jet boundary flux, where p-free external phases and the recurrent endpoint are controlled together.
rows.proof_boundary: A stronger source-specific joined-prefix theorem remains logically possible.

rows.claim: The next target is a whole-boundary joined-prefix first-jet estimate.
rows.formula: Insert the exact O(N) normalized first-jet flux into the cofinal boundary-degree contract. Seek strict boundary domination or a winding cap for the full joined prefix plus endpoint, beginning on the first unresolved compact boundary beyond Q_207.
rows.proof_boundary: One finite pilot is diagnostic and cannot establish the cofinal theorem.

rows.claim: The chain gate proves an exact obstruction, not RH.

Open: a joined Xi boundary margin, winding cap, q<1 chart, finite-height cofinal closure, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, and any Clay-prize conclusion.
